title: Creating a Putaway Location Group

children:
A putaway location group allows a series of received items to be putaway 
 as one group. The settings that define these groups are included in this 
 configuration. Once you create one putaway group (using either a location 
 range or a locating zone), then all 
 groups will have to be created using either ranges or zones, whichever 
 one you chose for the first group. When the system is performing locating, it locates to a location associated with a Putaway Group that includes the destination location selected during locating. It associates the receipt container to the existing Putaway Group. If there is not an existing Putaway Group for the destination location, the system will either create a new Putaway Group with the System ID or the user will assign a Putaway Group ID. The system will then update the Parent License Plate on the receiving dock inventory for this license plate with the Putaway Group ID. When work is executed, the pick is for the entire putaway group. One use of these groups is if you want 
 all returned items to be placed on a certain area of the receiving dock, 
 destined to be putaway either back into their original inventory locations, 
 or to a special returns "repair" area.
Using the Putaway Group Insight Screen

Access the Putaway Location Group Window. Create a new record and name 
 it.

Use the Warehouse 
 Field to indicate the warehouse where your putaway group will reside.

Use the Location 
 Range Field to identify the series of locations where product can 
 be putaway as part of your location group.

Use the Locating 
 Zone Field to identify the zone of locations where product can 
 be putaway as part of your location group.

Use the Group 
 Assignment Method Field to indicate if you want, upon creation, 
 a putaway location's Group ID to be manually assigned by the user, or 
 automatically assigned by the system.

Use the Maximum 
 Units Field to identify the most number of returned items that 
 can be included in a particular putaway group. If the maximum units number 
 is reached, then the system will close the group, and create a new group 
 based on the previous group's settings.

Use the One Per 
 User Checkbox to indicate that, if there are multiple users processing 
 returns, the system will assign each user's item(s) to separate putaway 
 groups. This will ensure that no two users will assign items to the same 
 putaway group.
Use the Verify Group ID Checkbox to indicate that the system will require you to enter the existing putaway group ID during the check in process.

Using the Quantity UM List 
 Tab

Use the Quantity 
 UM Field to indicate the eligible unit of measure(s) required for 
 returned items to be a part of this putaway group.
